profile.headline: L&T Technology Services reports 16% YoY growth in Q2FY26

description.text: L&T Technology Services (LTTS) is a global leader in engineering and technology services and a listed subsidiary of Larsen & Toubro (L&T). The company offers design, development, testing, and sustenance services across products and processes for clients across Mobility, Sustainability, and Tech segments.
description.quote: L&T Technology Services (LTTS) is a global leader in engineering and technology services. A listed subsidiary of Larsen & Toubro (L&T), we offer design, development, testing, and sustenance services across products and processes.

highlights.text: Revenue reached ₹ 29,795 million for the quarter, registering growth of 15.8% YoY and 4.0% QoQ.
highlights.quote: Revenue at ₹ 29,795 million; growth of 15.8% YoY and 4.0% QoQ

highlights.text: Net profit for Q2FY26 stood at ₹ 3,287 million, reflecting growth of 2.8% YoY and 4.1% QoQ.
highlights.quote: Net profit at ₹ 3,287 million, growth of 2.8% YoY and 4.1% QoQ

highlights.text: USD revenue reached $337 million, representing constant currency growth of 10.4% YoY and 1.3% QoQ.
highlights.quote: USD Revenue at $337 million; growth of 10.4% YoY and 1.3% QoQ in CC terms

highlights.text: The company achieved a record high large deal total contract value of near-USD 300 million during the quarter.
highlights.quote: Our strong momentum of large deal wins continued as we touched a record high TCV of near-USD 300 Mn in the quarter

highlights.text: The Board declared an Interim Dividend of ₹ 18 per share with a record date of October 27, 2025.
highlights.quote: Interim Dividend of ₹ 18 per share; record date October 27, 2025

keyHighlights.text: LTTS signed a $100 million multi-year agreement in its Sustainability segment with a U.S.-based industrial equipment manufacturer operating in the semiconductor value chain.
keyHighlights.quote: LTTS signed a $100 million multi-year agreement in its Sustainability segment with a U.S.-based industrial equipment manufacturer operating in the semiconductor value chain

keyHighlights.text: In the Tech segment, LTTS was awarded a ~$60 million multi-year program by a U.S.-based provider of wireless telecommunications services.
keyHighlights.quote: In the Tech segment, LTTS was awarded a ~$60 million multi-year program, by a U.S. based provider of wireless telecommunications services

keyHighlights.text: The Sustainability segment grew 3.0% sequentially and 12.6% annually, now holding a USD 50 Mn account on an annual run-rate basis.
keyHighlights.quote: The Sustainability segment grew 3.0% sequentially and 12.6% annually and now has a USD 50 Mn account on an annual run-rate basis.

keyHighlights.text: The company's patent filings crossed the 1,600 mark to 1,601, including 216 patents in AI/Gen AI.
keyHighlights.quote: Patent filings have crossed 1,600 mark, 216 patents in AI/Gen AI

keyHighlights.text: LTTS announced a multi-year membership agreement with the MIT Media Lab to collaborate on AI-led innovations across Mobility, Sustainability, and Tech segments.
keyHighlights.quote: LTTS announced a multi-year membership agreement with the MIT Media Lab to collaborate on AI-led innovations in its Mobility, Sustainability and Tech segments

outlook.text: LTTS expects both revenue and EBIT margins to see an improvement in H2 compared to H1 of FY26, aspires for double-digit growth in FY26, and maintains its medium-term outlook of USD 2 Bn revenue.
outlook.quote: With an increased order book and a sharp focus on resilient and profitable growth, we expect both revenue and EBIT margins to see an improvement in H2 compared to H1 of FY26. We aspire for a double-digit growth in FY26 and reiterate our medium-term outlook of USD 2 Bn revenue.

cell.quote: At the end of Q2 FY26, LTTS’ employee strength stood at 23,678.
over 23,670 employees across 23 global design centers
the patents portfolio of L&T Technology Services stood at 1,601
